title: The EV71 Neutralizing Antibody Test
author: Jian-Te Lee
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7pwhmpe

steps.title: Inactivate Serum
steps.instruction: Inactivate 300 μl of serum by heating at 56℃ for 30 min.

steps.title: Perform Serial Dilution of Serum
steps.instruction: Perform 2-fold serial dilutions of serum from 1:4 to 1:256 using 2% FBS DMEM.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 μl of 2% FBS DMEM into wells B through H
Add 50 μl of serum sample to the designated starting well
Dilute such that every well contains 50 μl of sample

steps.title: Prepare Control Wells
steps.instruction: Set up the following control wells:

substeps.instruction: Virus control: Back titration from 100, 10, 1 to 1/10 100TCID 50
Serum control: Add serum and cells only (no virus)
Cell control: Add cells only (no serum and no virus)

steps.title: Add Virus Suspension
steps.instruction: Add 50 μl of adjusted virus suspension (100TCID50EV71) to wells A through G of the microtiter plate and shake the reaction wells slightly.

steps.title: Incubate Virus and Serum
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction wells at 37℃ for 2 hours in a 5% CO2 incubator.

steps.title: Prepare RD Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Prepare RD cells suspension and adjust the cell concentration to 1×10^5/ml.

steps.title: Add RD Cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl of the adjusted RD cell suspension into each reaction well after the 2-hour incubation period.

steps.title: Incubate for CPE Development
steps.instruction: Incubate wells at 37℃ in a 5% CO2 incubator for 5-6 days until the virus control well reaches 100TCID 50.

steps.title: Observe and Verify CPE
steps.instruction: Observe Cytopathic Effect (CPE) in each well using a reverse microscope and verify control wells.

substeps.instruction: Virus control: Confirm 100% CPE in 100TCID 50 and 10TCID 50; 50% CPE in 1TCID 50; < 10% CPE in 1/10TCID 50

steps.title: Calculate NT Titer
steps.instruction: Calculate the Neutralizing Titer (NT) as the reciprocal value of the last dilution of the antiserum that completely inhibited the CPE.

substeps.instruction: Define seropositivity as a reciprocal serotiter ≥ 8
